description: Medium-density residential district (non-contextual designation without letter suffix). Governed by Quality Housing optional regulations OR Height Factor regulations. Two street configurations apply.

bulk.far_note: Wide street = within 100 ft of wide street. Narrow street = beyond 100 ft of wide street or only wide street frontage beyond 100 ft. Non-contextual so two options exist.

quality_housing.notes: Same as R6A when Quality Housing opted. Base height 40-65 ft; max building 75 ft.

height_factor.sky_exposure_plane: Governs Height Factor buildings. Base plane measured from street. Setback slope determined by district.
height_factor.notes: Sky exposure plane starts at approx 60 ft in R6 per §23-731. Height factor = building floor area / lot coverage.

height_setback.street_wall_setback_wide_st: 10 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_setback_narrow_st: 15 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.tower_permitted: Only per §23-435 tower regulations (non-contextual R6 through R9)

front.note: No front yard required in R6 through R12 per §23-342 exception

side.note: No rear yard required at lot line coinciding with adjoining side lot line

rear.through_lot_alternative: Rear yard equivalent per §23-343 on through lots ≥180 ft

permitted_uses.parking: 50% of dwelling units off-street; not permitted in front yard

dob_filing_notes: Determine street configuration first (wide vs narrow) — affects FAR and height limits
Quality Housing Option vs Height Factor Option requires analysis of lot and building program
NYC DOB: file Alt1 or NB. Height Factor buildings require open space ratio (OSR) calculations
